title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. I’ve had this tree for less than a month and the lights are flashing on and off so I am returning it. The branches are very flimsy and wrapped in tissue like paper and it’s very top heavy. I had to tape it to the floor to prevent it from falling over. The only the thing it has going for it, is easy assembly.
